judge.rationale: The candidate correctly accumulates token usage across all provider rounds in `chatOrchestrator.ts`, safely ignoring rounds without usage and preserving `undefined` when no rounds report usage. It meets every acceptance criterion, including renaming the hook parameter to `totalUsage`, introducing a `TotalUsage` type alias to make the contract unambiguous, updating the relevant specs and `CHANGELOG.md`, and leaving the existing single-round test untouched. It differs slightly from the reference by exporting the `TotalUsage` alias from `src/types/ai.ts`, placing its new behaviour under the 'Measured semantics' section of `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` instead of the main spec list, and adding a separate `.acceptance.test.ts` file alongside `.lore/dod.md`. Despite these minor organizational differences, the implementation is clean, complete, and functionally identical to the reference.
